english.title: Failed to evacuate following alarm - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, in an emergency failed to evacuate upon hearing an alarm requiring persons to evacuate

(A)_[Liverpool John Lennon Airport]_
(B)_[part of Liverpool John Lennon Airport, namely **(..SPECIFY PART OF AIRPORT..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 3(26) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
